verdict.rationale: Gusto serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.gusto.com/llms.txt, provides markdown-native versions of docs pages, and its separate CLI repo ships a dedicated AGENTS.md file with agent-specific conventions (install, auth, JSON envelopes, write-gating) confirmed via keyless curl — directly matching the 'point an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs' story. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor-probe) confirmation that agents actually consume these files successfully in practice.
